exposure: severe early-onset preeclampsia with intrauterine growth restriction
severe late-onset preeclampsia with intrauterine growth restriction
cohort: Five women with early-onset severe preeclampsia, five women with late-onset severe preeclampsia, and ten controls
finding: There are significant differences in placental gene expression between severe early- and late-onset preeclampsia when both are associated with intrauterine growth restriction.
